Author: Jacob5800
Name: Retainer Pricer
Description: Price eligible retainer listings with live marketboard or Universalis data and a configurable match or one-gil-undercut rule. Manage retainer ventures using the game's own retainer UI.
Punchline: Price listings and manage retainer ventures.
Changelog:
## 0.5.1.98

- Added Auto Desynthesis in Automation, off by default: after the venture steps and before listing, it leaves the bell, desynthesizes your listed items and opens the same bell again.
- Multi-character runs now show whether Lifestream is enabled, in green or red.
